d001.note: p001: the line «أ.د/ يسري رشدي السيد جبر الحسني» is printed clearly bold and larger (500 dpi zoom). The lines around it («جمع وترتيب الفقير إلى الله», «شيخ الطريقة…», «إمام وخطيب…») are regular weight. It contrasts, so it is marked **…** per CONVENTIONS §6. It is not a title-attribution line directly under the heading; a large gap separates it from the title block.

d002.note: p001: closes the bold span of the author-name line (see d001). The bold ends at «الحسني»; the next line «شيخ الطريقة…» is regular weight.

d003.note: p002: the print shows «٢٢٨٣٤» right after the colon of «رقم الإيداع:» and «٢٠١٧» at the far left, after the slash. Read in Arabic order (group by group, right to left, like the range rule in CONVENTIONS §2 and the date line «١٤٤٤هـ - ٢٠٢٣م» on the same page), this is number/year «٢٢٨٣٤/٢٠١٧», which is also the standard Egyptian deposit-number format (number/year). The digits are the same in both versions; only the logical order differs.
